name: ConfigiView – Simple Product & Material Configurator
author: Drazen

sections.description:
ConfigiView is a simple visual configurator designed for construction companies, contractors, and businesses that offer customizable materials or product options.

Create easy-to-use selection tools where visitors can choose colors, finishes, patterns, or predefined variations and view matching visual examples. Instead of complex real-time rendering, ConfigiView focuses on simplicity by displaying predefined visual combinations based on user selections.

This makes it fast, lightweight, and practical for real-world construction and renovation workflows.

Learn more and watch demo video.

Perfect for

  • Epoxy flooring configurators
  • Construction material selection
  • Surface finishes and coatings
  • Renovation planning tools
  • Custom building products
  • Material comparison interfaces

Key Features

  • Simple visual product configurator
  • Color, finish, and pattern selection
  • Predefined visual combinations
  • Lightweight and performance-friendly
  • Easy backend setup
  • Works with standard WordPress themes

How It Works

Create configuration options in the admin panel and assign images representing each variation. When visitors select an option, ConfigiView displays the corresponding predefined visual example.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/configiview directory, or install through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ConfigiView in admin to configure colors, patterns, previews, and inquiry CTA settings.
  4. Add shortcode [configiview] to any page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin create real-time visual rendering?

No. ConfigiView displays predefined visual examples instead of generating live rendered previews.

Who is this plugin for?

Construction companies, flooring specialists, contractors, renovation services, and businesses offering customizable materials or product options.

Can I use this for epoxy flooring configurators?

Yes. ConfigiView is ideal for epoxy flooring, surface finishes, coatings, and similar material-based visual configuration scenarios.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes, ConfigiView works with most standard WordPress themes.

Do I need coding knowledge?

No. All configuration can be managed from the WordPress dashboard.
